company.name: Stytch
company.shortDescription: Stytch improves security and user experience with passwordless authentication.
company.description:
Stytch improves security and user experience with passwordless authentication. Stytch is building the developer platform for authentication to enable teams to easily build experiences that delight their users.

The company was founded in 2020 and based in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: An embeddable admin UI that allows enterprise customers to self-manage authentication settings, SSO, SCIM, and organization configurations without involving the provider's team.
productsAndServices.name: Stytch Admin Portal

productsAndServices.description: Authentication methods including passkeys, breach-resistant passwords, and support for SAML SSO protocols for secure user access.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise-Grade Authentication

productsAndServices.description: A system that ensures reliable delivery of authentication emails and SMS messages by automatically switching between providers if one fails.
productsAndServices.name: SMS and Email Provider Failover

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables cross-application integrations, secure data sharing, and AI workflow activations by allowing apps to act as identity providers.
productsAndServices.name: Connected Apps

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables secure authentication and communication between services without human involvement.
productsAndServices.name: Machine-to-Machine Authentication

productsAndServices.description: Built-in multi-tenant architecture supporting organization-specific authentication policies, identity provider role mapping, just-in-time provisioning, and SCIM integration.
productsAndServices.name: Turnkey Multi-Tenancy
